findings.suggested_change: Under no circumstance and under no legal theory (tort, contract, or otherwise), shall either party be liable to the other party for any lost profits, loss of opportunity or other special, punitive, indirect, or consequential damages suffered by the other party arising in connection with this Agreement; and the maximum liability of each party in any way related to this Agreement (including any indemnification obligations) shall not exceed $2,000,000.00 (excluding any amounts due and payable pursuant to Section 8 hereunder).

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. Thank you for sharing the agreement. Before signing, I would like to propose a small adjustment. - In the relevant clause, the indemnification obligations are excluded from the overall liability cap, leaving potential liability for those claims uncapped. I propose modifying the agreement so that the maximum liability of each party in any way related to the agreement (including any indemnification obligations) shall not exceed $2,000,000.00 (excluding any amounts due and payable pursuant to Section 8 hereunder). Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
